name: backend
description: Directus 11 backend — data model, schema-as-code, and all server-side logic (in extensions/app).

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && npm run directus:start
scripts.typecheck: if ls migrations/*.mts >/dev/null 2>&1; then tsc --noEmit -p migrations; else echo 'No migrations to typecheck.'; fi && npm run typecheck --prefix extensions/app
scripts.build:migrations: if ls migrations/*.mts >/dev/null 2>&1; then tsc -p migrations; else echo 'No migrations to compile.'; fi
scripts.build:extensions: for d in extensions/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; [ -f "$d/package-lock.json" ] || { echo "✖ $d has no package-lock.json — run 'npm install' in it once and commit the lockfile"; exit 1; }; (cd "$d" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build); done
scripts.build: npm run build:migrations && npm run build:extensions
scripts.database:migrate: npm run build:migrations && npx directus database migrate:latest
scripts.schema:load: if [ -f schema/snapshot/info.json ]; then directus-sync push; else echo 'schema/ enthaelt noch keinen Dump — schema:load uebersprungen. Erst "npm run schema:dump" ausfuehren.'; fi
scripts.directus:init: ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@wepublish.ch ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 PUBLIC_URL=/ DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PASSWORD=password KEY=59ccea19-23112-4a08-8sw72-dd2312341412 SECRET=1234 MIGRATIONS_PATH=./migrations/keine npx directus bootstrap && npm run schema:load && npm run database:migrate
scripts.directus:start: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; CACHE_ENABLED=false EXTENSIONS_AUTO_RELOAD=true PUBLIC_URL=/ DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PASSWORD=password KEY=59ccea19-23112-4a08-8sw72-dd2312341412 SECRET=1234 npx directus start
scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env; npm install && npm run build
